# Browser dependencies

- SheetJS Community Edition 0.18.5: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/xlsx@0.18.5/dist/xlsx.full.min.js (Apache-2.0)
- Chart.js 4.4.7: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.7/dist/chart.umd.min.js (MIT)

Original distribution headers retained. Bundled locally so workbook parsing and charts do not depend on a third-party script host during use.
